Hillerød is a Danish municipality referenced in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database, published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. The report evaluates clinical quality in atrial fibrillation treatment across national, regional, and municipal levels, providing detailed benchmarking data for all 98 Danish municipalities [^src1]. Hillerød is specifically listed in the dataset for Indicator 5, which tracks the prevention of ischemic stroke (apopleksi) through anticoagulant treatment using DanStroke registry calculations [^src1]. 

Because the available evidence is limited to a single tabular row, no further claims, historical timeline, or related entities are documented in the corpus for Hillerød.
